# Shared tools: immutable snapshot

`gems57/` is copied without modifications from `buffedlizard55-lab/60GEMSDOE`,
commit `32024716f218d06a94e01464157392119c03cb15`, `src/gems57/`.
Every file's SHA-256 and Git blob ID are in `evidence/template-pin.json`.
This preserves upstream provenance; it is not a claim of organizer endorsement.
Upstream comments describing other sessions are not new measurements from GEMSDOE75.

Our audit uses the shared gates/uniqueness modules. The evaluator and submission writer
are available for reuse but were not used to train, evaluate or emit a competition candidate.
Synthetic tests exercise portions of both. Any discovered shared-tool defect must be
reported/fixed in the template, not by editing this snapshot. The 12-pixel segment cap and
positive-support interpretation are flagged for review in docs/review.md, not silently changed.
